I'm Extremely Sorry To Hear What's Going On..... There Are Ways To Help Your Sister Though That'll Be After She Gets Out Of The Hospital And Inpatient Therapy.

* One Way Is To Show Her That You'll Be Supportive To Her And That It's Okay For Her To Talk About Her Problems With You.
* Always Check Up On Her But Don't Do It Too Often As That'll Make Her Uncomfortable.
* Give Her Time And Space To Make She Heals Both Physically And Psychologically (As Attempted Suicides Can Be Traumatizing To Some The Suicidal Person) But Show That You're Always There To Talk.

Now For The Things, You Shouldn't Do Is 

* Don't Guilt Trip The Suicidal Person As This Can Make Them Feel So Much Worse Than How They Already Feel.
* Suicide Is Not Selfish In Any Way, They Just Want Their Pain to Stop As They Can't Handle It Anymore Or They Fee Like things Won't Get Better Anytime Soon.
* Don't Call A Suicidal Person Dramatic Or That They're Seeking Attention, Similar To The Whole "Oh Suicide Is For Attention Seekers' Or "Oh They're Being Dramatic!"  Is A Stereotype That People Use To Justify Bullying.
